insight: Launched March 14, 2023 as an OpenAI showcase partner — the same day GPT-4 was released to the public.
name: Khanmigo
tagline: Khan Academy's AI tutor and teaching assistant.
description: An AI-powered tutor and teaching assistant from Khan Academy that guides learners through math, science, coding, and the humanities. Rather than handing over answers, it uses Socratic prompts to push students toward their own reasoning. For teachers it drafts lesson plans, rubrics, and exit tickets aligned to Khan Academy's content library.
edge: Coaches via Socratic questioning instead of giving answers, grounded in Khan Academy's vetted K-12 curriculum.
pros: Drafts lesson plans and rubrics for teachers
